posts.title: The audit log that won finance teams' trust
posts.excerpt: A bare audit_log table, three rules for what goes in it, and a React side-panel UI. The single feature that turned skepticism into adoption on month-end close — same product, same UX, same charts, one feature decided it.
posts.imageAlt: Finance dashboard — React, Node and PostgreSQL with audit log

posts.title: The JWT + HTTP-only cookie auth I reuse on every project
posts.excerpt: Why localStorage JWTs are an XSS disaster, and the exact HTTP-only cookie + refresh token rotation setup I copy-paste into every React + Node project. Originally built for NeoMail, now in every dashboard since.
posts.imageAlt: NeoMail email client — where this auth setup originated

posts.title: MongoDB TTL indexes — auto-expire in one line, no cron
posts.excerpt: NeoMail expires old messages automatically with no cron, no scheduler, no cleanup code. The entire feature is one MongoDB index. When TTL indexes are the right tool, when they aren't, and the gotchas that catch most teams.
posts.imageAlt: NeoMail — uses a MongoDB TTL index for message expiry

posts.title: My 12-step onboarding doc for every freelance project
posts.excerpt: Every freelance dispute I've heard about traces back to something that should have been agreed in week one and wasn't. This is the document I fill in with every new client during the discovery week. 12 items, ~30 minutes, zero post-kickoff surprises.
